name: control-track rhythmic filter and WT animation
goal: Use dual Control Tracks (sequenced controller lanes) as the heartbeat: up to 16 steps, ping-pong, DAW-synced rates, swing/gate/depth, routing to filter cutoff, wavetable position, or any mod destination.

source.title: TRAVELER: The Cinematic Hybrid Synthesizer | Official Walkthrough

prerequisites: Hybrid synth or Traveler-inspired Web Audio engine with multi-osc, stereo filter, envelopes, LFOs/mod matrix, sequenced control tracks (or automation), and FX (EQ/chorus/delay/reverb)

inputs.name: track_a_destination
inputs.description: e.g. filter cutoff, WT position, osc mix

outputs.name: control_track_patch
outputs.description: Patch with rhythmic Control Track animation

constraints: Original synthesis only; not affiliated with KeySolutions; do not rip Traveler samples/presets/wavetables.
Original synthesis only — design new patches from portable parameters; do not copy proprietary Traveler factory preset names, banks, wavetables, or samples.
Not affiliated with KeySolutions Sounds or Traveler; concepts mapped to generic hybrid-synth / Web Audio equivalents.
Do not rip, dump, or redistribute Traveler content.
Prefer recreating the described signal-flow and motion relationships in our browser music system or any hybrid synth with comparable modules.

steps.action: Open sequencer/Control Tracks panel. Configure Track A: length ≤16 steps, direction forward or ping-pong, tempo-synced note value.
Set Track A destination from the shared mod destination list (same as mod matrix): e.g. filter cutoff or wavetable position. Set depth, gate time, swing.
Configure Track B with a complementary destination and optionally different length/rate for evolving polyrhythmic motion.
steps.expect: Second motion layer independent of A

steps.action: Use utilities: copy A→B, reverse/flip, reset, or randomize steps when exploring — then refine by ear.
steps.expect: Useful starting pattern without staying on pure random

steps.action: Optionally pair with arpeggiator: many patterns; can target individual oscillators so one osc arps while another holds a pad; shape arp attacks with mod envelope when per-osc selected.
steps.expect: Arp + control tracks create complementary motion

verification: Motion remains useful over long holds
